domestic.en: Domestic abuse charities have argued that the show makes light of violence in the home.
domestic.zh: 家庭虐待慈善机构认为，该节目将家庭暴力轻描淡写。

domestic.en: It's unpredictable, it is aggressive, and it's very hard to keep in a " domestic " setting.
domestic.zh: 它难以预测、极具攻击性，而且很难将其保持在“家养”的环境中。

domestic.en: But with few washing machines and no running water, these domestic chores take a long time.
domestic.zh: 但是由于缺乏洗衣机且没有自来水，这些家务活需要很长时间。

domestic.en: It did not cover casual labourers, domestic servants, or the self-employed.
domestic.zh: 它不包括临时工、家政仆人或自谋职业者。

domestic.en: And the fire restructured domestic life in practical ways too.
domestic.zh: 火也在实际层面上重构了家庭生活。

doubt.en: The phrase a question mark around something means there's doubt or uncertainty about something.
doubt.zh: 短语“对某事打上问号（a question mark around something）”意思是某事存在怀疑或不确定性。

doubt.en: You have no doubt. A stigma is an unfair, negative belief about something.
doubt.zh: 你毫无疑问。“污名”（stigma）是指对某事物不公平的负面看法。

doubt.en: "If in doubt, throw it out!" is a very good phrase to say.
doubt.zh: “如有疑虑，扔掉它！”是一句非常好的话。

doubt.en: I’m Phil. And I’m Beth. Love it or hate it, there’s no doubt fast food is popular.
doubt.zh: 我是 Phil。我是 Beth。不管你是爱是恨，快餐无疑是非常受欢迎的。

doubt.en: And wealth existed alongside poverty. Rio is, without a doubt, Brazil’s most internationally famous city.
doubt.zh: 财富与贫困并存。毫无疑问，里约是巴西在国际上最著名的城市。

dominate.en: One language might dominate your professional life while another belongs to your home life.
dominate.zh: 一种语言可能支配你的职业生活，而另一种语言则属于你的家庭生活。

dominate.en: So, a fight response is usually when we try to dominate or belittle other people.
dominate.zh: 所以，“战斗”反应通常是我们试图支配或贬低其他人的时候。

dominate.en: Instead of allowing their resources to dominate their economies, they have used it to build prosperity.
dominate.zh: 它们没有让资源主导自己的经济，而是用资源来建立繁荣。

dominate.en: Indeed. And Caroline goes on to say how the atmosphere of TRAPPIST-1e is dominated by nitrogen.
dominate.zh: 的确。Caroline 接着说到 TRAPPIST-1e 的大气层是如何被氮气主导的。

dominate.en: Both of these islands have histories that was heavily dominated by the sugar industry and slavery.
dominate.zh: 这两座岛屿的历史都深受糖业和奴隶制的支配。

document.en: The delegates who signed this document were effectively committing treason against the British Crown.
document.zh: 签署这份文件的代表实际上是在犯下针对英国王室的叛国罪。

document.en: And their official documents, like passports or parliamentary debates, are available in both languages.
document.zh: 他们的官方文件，比如护照或议会辩论记录，都有这两种语言的版本。

document.en: There are 42 documented assassination attempts, with presumably many more than this that were never discovered.
document.zh: 有记录的暗杀企图就有42次，据推测还有更多从未被发现的暗杀。

document.en: Then, in 1215, came Magna Carta — the great document forced on King John by his barons.
document.zh: 然后，到了1215年，《大宪章》(Magna Carta)问世——这是由男爵们强迫约翰(King John)国王签署的一份伟大文件。

document.en: For example: “ChatGPT, can you make a summary of this document?
document.zh: 例如：“ChatGPT，你能总结一下这份文档吗？

doom.en: If you say, " We're doomed!" you mean we're going to be defeated or fail.
doom.zh: 如果你说“We're doomed!”，意思是我们将遭遇失败或完蛋了。

doom.en: When Nish says this, James exclaims, " We're doomed!" – an informal way of saying we're destined to fail.
doom.zh: 当Nish这么说时，James惊呼道：“We're doomed!”（我们完了！）——这是一种非正式的说法，意指我们注定要失败。

doom.en: You can't go in all guns blazing. You can't go… and that's what we hear all the time: "This weekend, I'm going to sort out my whole room of doom." And after two hours in, they will look around and go, "What have I done?
doom.zh: 你不能一上来就大张旗鼓。你不能……这也是我们经常听到的：“这个周末，我要把我的‘厄运房间’整个整理一遍。”两个小时后，他们会环顾四周说：“我都干了些什么啊？

downward.en: And a downward spiral is a situation which continuously gets worse and worse.
downward.zh: 而“downward spiral”（恶性循环）是指一种不断恶化的情况。

downward.en: From the age of eight our hearing is on a downward spiral – a situation which gets worse and worse.
downward.zh: 从八岁起，我们的听力就在走下坡路——这种情况会变得越来越糟。

dormitory.en: Open dormitories. Shared dining halls with long, visible sight lines.
dormitory.zh: 开放式宿舍。共享的餐厅，视线长且一览无余。

donate.en: They donate money to politicians. They are on friendly terms with influential government figures.
donate.zh: 他们向政治家捐款。他们与有影响力的政府人物保持着友好的关系。

donate.en: He collected maps. He collected clocks. He had an enormous personal library that, after his death, was donated to what became the British Library: 65,000 volumes.
donate.zh: 他收集地图。他收集时钟。他拥有庞大的个人图书馆，在他死后被捐赠给了日后的英国国家图书馆：藏书量达 65,000 册。

donate.en: And interestingly enough, this report compared the data on expected wallet return with data on other acts of “caring” for fellow citizens, such as donating to charity, volunteering, or helping a stranger.
donate.zh: 有趣的是，这份报告将关于“预期钱包被归还”的数据与关于为同胞提供其他“关怀”行为（如向慈善机构捐款、做志愿者或帮助陌生人）的数据进行了对比。

dominant.en: Others had been diplomatically absorbed, sucked up by this increasingly dominant power.
dominant.zh: 另一些则是通过外交手段被吞并，被这个日益主导的强权所蚕食。

dominant.en: The dominant genre was the Western. Cowboys and sheriffs and open plains.
dominant.zh: 当时最主流的电影类型是西部片：牛仔、警长，还有辽阔的平原。

dominant.en: So how did English eventually become the dominant language across Canada?
dominant.zh: 那么，英语最终是如何成为整个加拿大的主流语言的呢？

dominant.en: Under his leadership, his political party, the People’s Action Party, became the dominant political force in Singapore.
dominant.zh: 在他的领导下，他的政党——人民行动党，成为了新加坡占主导地位的政治力量。

dominant.en: Quebec has introduced laws to ensure that French is the dominant language in schools, businesses, and public life.
dominant.zh: 魁北克已经出台了相关法律，以确保法语在学校、企业和公共生活中占主导地位。

dock.en: They built roads and docks and schools and hospitals and other infrastructure.
dock.zh: 他们修建了道路、码头、学校、医院和其他基础设施。

dock.en: Now, fast-forward three centuries. It is February 1985, and a man named Clive Ponting is sitting in the dock at the Old Bailey — London's most famous criminal court.
dock.zh: 现在，时间快进三个世纪。1985年2月，一个名叫克莱夫·庞廷(Clive Ponting)的人坐在老贝利(Old Bailey)——伦敦最著名的刑事法院——的被告席上。

documentary.en: It’s also often featured in documentaries for its unique natural environment.
documentary.zh: 它也经常因其独特的自然环境而出现在纪录片中。

documentary.en: You might have seen this on the internet or on nature documentaries.
documentary.zh: 你可能在互联网上或自然纪录片里看到过这个。

documentary.en: His story has been told in books, documentaries, and films.
documentary.zh: 他的故事已经被搬上了书籍、纪录片和电影。

documentary.en: Practice writing every week. Or Watch at least one English documentary or YouTube video or TV episode every week.
documentary.zh: 每周练习写作。或者每周至少看一部英语纪录片、YouTube 视频或电视剧集。

documentary.en: There was a really good BBC documentary from 1970 with an interview of a southern woman who married a northern man.
documentary.zh: 1970年有一部非常出色的 BBC 纪录片，采访了一位嫁给北方男人的南方女性。
